observations.description: Original 3D cartoon animation in the same character style: country road, sheriff, cars and a roadside tree stump.
The key concept is named inside the world on a highway sign ('TARGET FIXATION') instead of an overlay title.
Driver point-of-view sequence through the windscreen for the explanation part.
Sunny daylight for the setup, dark stormy night lighting for the climax.
Captions show 1-2 words at a time in sentence case with punctuation kept; white heavy rounded sans-serif with a thin dark outline and soft shadow, centred just below the middle of the frame.
Ironic ending: the character who mocked the crashes hits the same stump.
Hook is a single concrete paradox stated immediately: "If you plant a tree beside an empty road, cars will steer right into it."
Ends on a concrete payoff that resolves the hook, no call to action: "Even when it's just a stump."

categorical.hook_style: one-sentence concrete paradox (strange action, absurd consequence, or rule + contradiction), no intro
categorical.ending_style: concrete payoff image that resolves the hook, then the video stops (no CTA, no summary)
